# StereoFine 1.1 — Release candidate 3

Historical test build of the revised automatic stereo alignment and depth-measurement pipeline.

- Improve automatic alignment and correction of residual vertical errors.
- Improve near/far-point detection and handling of small foreground areas.

For normal use, choose the [stable StereoFine 1.1 release](https://github.com/muelli1975/StereoFine/releases/tag/v1.1).

Keep test builds separate from a stable installation. Archives include their source snapshot under `Source/`.

See the [validation report](https://github.com/muelli1975/StereoFine/blob/development/1.1/docs/VALIDATION_1.1_RC1.md) for technical test details.
